verdict.rationale: DBOS documents patching and versioning strategies for safely upgrading workflow code, and Conductor is described as able to "version, fork, replay" workflows. You can also review step checkpoints and restart a workflow from a specific step. However, review covers execution history rather than changes to the automation definition, and fork/restart re-runs an execution rather than reverting to an earlier workflow version. Missing for 10: documented rollback of workflow code to a prior version, review/diff of automation changes before deploy, in-depth detail on versioning mechanics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: DBOS supports two strategies for safely upgrading workflow code: patching and versioning.
